purpose: Machine-readable record of every third-party container image and binary the product, the local audit, and the certification workflows depend on. backend/tests/test_third_party_image_lock.py fails the build if a reference site and this file disagree.

minio_object_store.why: The upstream vendor archived the open-source MinIO Server, Client and KES and stopped serving community release files (see the note in docs/known-issues.md). A tag is a mutable pointer into a registry whose retention policy we do not control, and this image stores certified evidence, so the release line pins content by digest and re-derives the digest from the vendor's signed release tag before changing it.
minio_object_store.upgrade_procedure: 1) resolve the new tag at https://quay.io/v2/minio/minio/manifests/<tag> with an Accept header for the docker/oci manifest LIST (a bare request returns a legacy schema1 conversion whose digest differs); 2) confirm the image config labels carry release=<tag> and vendor=MinIO Inc; 3) confirm the matching PGP-signed tag in github.com/minio/minio was created minutes before the image build timestamp; 4) update this file, then run the object-store certification (pytest -m object_store + the Linux/GA workflows) before any release.

postgres.why: postgres:16-alpine remains a Docker Hub official-library image, so the tag is maintained upstream; the version matrix certification (§6 of the release checklist) runs the migration chain against pinned Debian-suffix variants instead. Recorded here so a future archive event is visible in one place.
postgres.upgrade_procedure: Resolve and record the digest here, then re-run the PostgreSQL version matrix.

images.name: minio-object-store
images.role: S3-compatible durable evidence store (docker-compose deployment, kind certification clusters, GitHub service containers, scripts/certification/setup.sh)
images.digest_kind: manifest-list (multi-arch); the linux/amd64 platform manifest is sha256:3f97c5651cb6662b880c787a232b6b34fec8d8922e08d6617b25d241a21164bb
images.previous_ref_status: Unusable. Pulled successfully from GitHub runners as late as 2026-08-22 (outputs evidence: _ci_logs/cert_run8_full.log, 'deployment "minio" successfully rolled out'), then every certification job from 2026-09-13 on failed at container initialisation with 'Error response from daemon: pull access denied for minio/minio, repository does not exist or may require docker login'.

provenance.repository_namespace: quay.io organisation 'minio' (is_organization=true, description 'Multi-Cloud Object Storage'), whose ~500 tags follow the vendor's full community release cadence including hotfix builds
provenance.vendor_signed_tag: github.com/minio/minio tag RELEASE.2025-04-22T22-12-26Z, annotated object f19c534b9f457773dcd043d977433e1a71525c3b, PGP-signed by 'Minio Trusted <trusted@minio.io>' at 2025-04-22T22:34:02Z, peeling to commit 0d7408fc9969caf07de6a8c3a84f9fbb10a6739e
provenance.open_gap: The vcs-ref above is not resolvable in the public minio/minio or minio/docker-minio repositories (GitHub returns 422/404), and docker.io was unreachable from the audit host, so byte-for-byte equality with the image previously certified from Docker Hub could not be proven offline. It is proven behaviourally instead: the object_store certification and the Linux/GA jobs run this image and exercise real S3 signatures, multipart evidence upload, versioning and the DR restore path against it.

images.name: postgres
images.role: Primary metadata store (docker-compose, kind clusters, GitHub service containers)

binaries.name: mc
binaries.role: MinIO client used by the DR/backup gates in the GA certification and soak workflows
binaries.install_contract: curl -fSsL (fails on an HTTP error page) + sha256sum --check against the published .sha256sum, exit 1 on mismatch
binaries.why_not_dl_min_io: dl.min.io returns HTTP 410 Gone for every community release asset after the archive; the bootstrap that read from it installed an HTML error page as /usr/local/bin/mc because curl lacked -f, which is how the GA and soak jobs failed from 2026-09-13.

binaries.name: kind
binaries.role: Kubernetes-in-Docker cluster used by the K8s and GA certification workflows
binaries.install_contract: curl -fSsL --retry 3 (a non-fatal curl would install an error page)
